title: Narra 4.1.10
message: A smoother release with richer discovery, reliable resume controls, and improved playback.
changelog: Home and bottom navigation now keep their correct destinations while live shelves load efficiently.
Discover adds richer audiobook, book, and manga sections with working View All destinations.
Asian Drama playback can select real audio tracks when a stream provides multiple languages.
Manga details now resume the exact last-read chapter instead of returning to chapter one.
Audiobook and manga entry ads now pause content correctly, respect Premium, and recover when the primary ad is unavailable.
The installed APK, Profile page, and updater now agree on build 16.
